messages.subject: fluidpage/fixedpage with CSS file
parts:
Anyone else having issues trying to use their own CSS theme in the new development version of Shiny?  I have tried several CSS files, all compatible with Bootstrap 2.3.2, and all seem to create issues with fluidpage or fixedpage displaying correctly. Using one of the example pieces of code from Github works fine until I add a theme using the default CSS for Rstudio, at which point the columns and rows do not display as expected.  

UI CODE
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  theme="markdown.css",
  fluidRow(
    column(4,
           "4"
    ),
    column(4, offset = 4,
           "4 offset 4"
    )      
  ),
  fluidRow(
    column(3, offset = 3,
           "3 offset 3"
    ),
    column(3, offset = 3,
           "3 offset 3"
    )  
  )
))

markdown.css
body, td {
   font-family: sans-serif;
   background-color: white;
   font-size: 12px;
   margin: 8px;
}

tt, code, pre {
   font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Droid Sans Mono', 'Lucida Console', Consolas, Monaco, monospace;
}

h1 { 
   font-size:2.2em; 
}

h2 { 
   font-size:1.8em; 
}

h3 { 
   font-size:1.4em; 
}

h4 { 
   font-size:1.0em; 
}

h5 { 
   font-size:0.9em; 
}

h6 { 
   font-size:0.8em; 
}

a:visited {
   color: rgb(50%, 0%, 50%);
}

pre {        
   margin-top: 0;
   max-width: 95%;
   border: 1px solid #ccc;
   white-space: pre-wrap;
}

pre code {
   display: block; padding: 0.5em;
}

code.r, code.cpp {
   background-color: #F8F8F8;
}

table, td, th {
  border: none;
}

blockquote {
   color:#666666;
   margin:0;
   padding-left: 1em;
   border-left: 0.5em #EEE solid;
}

hr {
   height: 0px;
   border-bottom: none;
   border-top-width: thin;
   border-top-style: dotted;
   border-top-color: #999999;
}

@media print {
   * { 
      background: transparent !important; 
      color: black !important;

      -ms-filter: none !important;

   body {

   a, a:visited { 
      text-decoration: underline; 
   }

   hr {

      page-break-before: always;

      page-break-inside: avoid;

      max-width: 100% !important;

      margin: 15mm 20mm 15mm 10mm;

}

messages.author: 8e965e659c833ed8
messages.subject: Re: fluidpage/fixedpage with CSS file
parts:
Hi there,

The custom bootstrap CSS must be a full replacement for the default bootstrap CSS (i.e. a valid bootstrap theme). Using markdown.css from RStudio therefore won't work. See bootswatch for a few compatible themes: http://bootswatch.com/2/ 

Note that when using any theme you should make sure it targets bootstrap 2 rather than bootstrap 3.

Best,

J.J.

messages.author: 8e965e659c833ed8
messages.subject: Re: fluidpage/fixedpage with CSS file
parts:
Trying out the slate.css theme locally works fine for me. My guess is that the slate.css file isn't getting loaded. You can confirm this by doing a View Source in the browser and then clicking on the link to slate.css to see if it's found.

Is slate.css located in your www directory or at the top level? (the www directory is where it should be).

J.J.
